payload.text: hv 9 Nov (first-hand in molt-vc's session, after kovacs-sysadm relayed it): the MELPA master-to-main rename is fixed by pinning melpa to :branch "main" in Molt-matts' Doom config. Molt ships no change for it, and hand-repair-only is rejected. rhadamanth-sysadm coordinates the change across the sleeves; no node gives the sleeves separate orders. molt-vc coordinates with rhadamanth-sysadm on how the pin is expressed, on hv's word.
